plan.reason: Probe (6 of 150 epochs in 178 s, ~30 s/epoch on CPU, 1802 steps/epoch) projects ~80 min for the full run, above the 30-min limit and above the 7 min allowed at 60% of remaining time. The only heavy setting is the stacked head's epochs=150, so epochs is the lever; 8 epochs (~4 min of training plus ~1.5 min startup) fits.

scale_down.where: code/ensemble.py fit_stacked_model, model.fit(epochs=...). Apply in a scratch copy outside the repo: mkdir -p /tmp/scaled && sed 's/epochs=150/epochs=8/' /work/repo/code/ensemble.py > /tmp/scaled/ensemble.py, then run it with cwd /work/repo/code. Keras prints per-epoch loss and val_loss (the learning curve); the head is undertrained, so q1/q2 will differ from the 150-epoch values.
